name: Sushiya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood sushi shop: a holiday-change notice, a first day working part-time, a menu guide, a touch-panel-order trial, a delivery plans guide, a lesson in customer manners, teaching a junior how to shape sushi rice, the shop's history of changing its vinegar-rice recipe, a service guide, a touch-panel-order trend column, a hybrid discount-day system, a reflection on balancing efficiency and connection, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
